findings.text: follow-on: the manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty, naming the base and head arms only in test_logs; the review derived the added-failure count by reading base-import-population.log and head-import-population.log directly (head failures are a subset of base, 0 added), but the read-time annotation reads the manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite fields and will report the count as unmeasured, so the node should populate those two fields.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 72332071f; 73d24ea57 routes service.unit_path through systemd_user_dir(), adds write_named_unit and SystemdUserUnitManager, moves the watcher render into service.render_watch_unit, deletes SystemdUserWatchService and paid_lanes._write_if_changed, and adds the focused test; 62afe27f2 adds only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: all five clauses hold and were verified at head 62afe27f2: service.unit_path() resolves through paid_lanes.systemd_user_dir(); SystemdUserUnitManager threads unit name and log path through the shared installer; a focused test sets XDG_CONFIG_HOME to a temp dir and asserts reckon.service and a project's watch unit both land under it; the importing population (218 base -> 219 head files) adds no failure against base; the negative control restores a hardcoded path and the XDG assertion fails.
item_verdicts.goal: every systemd user unit resolves through the XDG-aware resolver and the watcher renders, writes and controls its unit through reckon/service.py, parameterised by unit name, rather than a parallel class with copied logic.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 73d24ea57 and 62afe27f2, but its baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty and the base/head arms are named only in test_logs (base-import-population.log, head-import-population.log).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the diff against base 72332071f touches exactly reckon/service.py, reckon/crew/runs.py, reckon/crew/paid_lanes.py, tests/test_one_systemd_unit_resolver_and_installer.py and the declared evidence fragment; the declared figures directory is correctly left unwritten as no figure was named.

justifications.durability: the focused test travels the real seams through service.write_unit, service.SystemdUserUnitManager and runs.ensure_watcher_service, asserts both the server and watch units land under a temp XDG_CONFIG_HOME and the exact systemctl argv, isolates RECKON_HOME and the executable, and the negative control shows the guard fires; docked because the restart=True branch of SystemdUserUnitManager.start and the directory parameter of install_timer are not independently exercised.
justifications.evidence: the base and head arms are real population runs with headers naming their revision and tree (base-import-population.log 72332071f, head-import-population.log 73d24ea57), the negative control reddens exactly test_service_and_watch_units_use_the_xdg_systemd_directory with a real assertion diff, and the focused gate progressed from 1 failed to 54 passed after repair; docked because the reviewed manifest left baseline_suite and after_suite empty, so reading the record through annotate_review_of_run derives the added-failure count as unmeasured rather than the zero the arms support.
justifications.fit: the change follows the section exactly - one resolver (systemd_user_dir) and one content-preserving installer (write_named_unit) reached by the server, the watcher, the refresh timer and the watch manager - keeps the fake-manager seam, imports paid_lanes at module top while paid_lanes imports service lazily so no cycle forms, and removes the duplicated render and write logic; docked one point for the residual service<->paid_lanes coupling introduced by making service depend on paid_lanes for directory resolution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: every done-when clause is met and independently reproduced - the negative control (negative-hardcoded-path.log, EXIT=1) proves the old hardcoded path is gone, the base/head population arms show head failures a subset of base (7 failed+1 error -> 4 failed+1 error), and a live import at head finds unit_path() routed through systemd_user_dir(); docked one point because the head population arm (head-import-population.log) names revision 73d24ea57, the code commit, not the recorded head 62afe27f2, so a reader must reconcile the arm revision with the anchor commit that adds only the fragment.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff against 72332071f modifies exactly the four declared product/test paths and the declared fragment, writes no figure while declaring none was named, leaves the worktree clean at 62afe27f2, commits with conventional subjects and bodies and no AI trailer, and uses no plan labels in names or comments.
